content: new Date('2026-01-15') parses as UTC midnight; in timezones behind UTC (all of Brazil, UTC-3) this displays as the previous day evening. Fix: parse date-only values as explicit local time (append T00:00:00) or use Temporal.PlainDate / a date-only type, never a UTC-based Date for calendar dates. Brazil abolished DST in 2019, simplifying but not eliminating the bug.
